name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd.
about: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited produces and sells alcoholic beverages in India and internationally. The company offers whisky, brandy, rum, vodka, and gin under the Arthaus, Officer's Choice, Sterling Reserve Blend 7, ICONiQ Winter, X&O Barrel, Srishti, Officer's Choice Blue, Sterling Reserve, Officer's Choice Star, Kyron, Jolly Roger, Class 21, and Zoya brand names. It also provides packaged drinking water under the Officer's Choice Blue, Sterling Reserve, and ICONiQ White brand names. Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~42% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.9% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 103 vs sector median 41; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 38, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 650% a year while PE moved 5262 → 103.
